newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Drazek-EU to use subsidies despite concern.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Drazek-EU to use subsidies despite concern.

text.p: The European Union plans to use subsidies to move its wheat crop despite U.S. concerns, Agriculture Department senior trade adviser Paul Drazek said after talks in Brussels Tuesday, and reiterated the U.S. was prepared to take "appropriate steps" to protect market share.

"It's clear from what I was told that the intention of the Europeans at this point is to continue to subsidize despite our concerns about it," Drazek said in a interview with USDA Radio Tuesday after talks with European Commission officials in which both sides appeared at loggerheads over the issue.
Drazek said Europe has had the second largest wheat crop in its history and feels the need to use export subsidies to move it into the world market.
